description: Source code for the PUSCH power control logic in a 5G NR scheduler, including power adjustment, PHR handling, and TPC command computation.

classes.name: pusch_power_controller
classes.description: Class managing PUSCH power control, including configuration reloading, PRB adjustment based on PHR, and TPC command generation.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reloads PUSCH power control configuration from UE cell configuration.

methods.name: update_pusch_pw_ctrl_state
methods.description: Updates the power control grid with the latest slot and PRB count.

methods.name: handle_phr
methods.description: Processes PHR reports to estimate path loss and adjust power control parameters.

methods.name: adapt_pusch_prbs_to_phr
methods.description: Adjusts the number of PRBs for PUSCH based on latest PHR to prevent power reduction.

methods.name: compute_tpc_command
methods.description: Calculates the TPC command based on SINR difference and power control constraints.
